verdict.rationale: Navan's developer portal explicitly states that no OpenAPI or Swagger document exists: spec-style paths serve the landing shell, and the API reference is static curl/Node examples. The published llms.txt and markdown MCP guide are AI-readable documentation indexes, not a machine-readable API spec, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
